title: Care Desk Guidance — Extending a Reservation Hold on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
A buyer who has not yet signed the purchase agreement may ask to extend the reservation hold on an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements. The extension length and the number of extensions allowed are the figures of the order's vehicle program.

**The rule.**
1. A hold is extended only on an order whose status is reserved.
2. The extension is requested no later than the hold expiration date recorded on the order. There is no grace period after that date: the grace allowed is 0 calendar days, and a request on the hold expiration date itself is in time.
3. The order's extensions used must be below the program's maximum hold extensions.
4. Each extension moves the hold expiration date later by the program's hold extension days, counted in calendar days from the current hold expiration date; it never restarts from the request date.
5. An extension does not change the deposit, which stays held.
6. A request made after the hold has lapsed is refused; the customer must reserve again if the vehicle is still listed.

All three conditions (reserved status, timing, extensions used) are read from the order record.

**Points of judgement.**

| Request made on | Extensions used versus allowed | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| A day before the hold expiration date | below the maximum | extended |
| The hold expiration date itself | below the maximum | extended |
| The day after the hold expiration date | any | refused; the hold has lapsed |
| Any day up to the hold expiration date | equal to the maximum | not extended |

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A Kestrel Certified order has a hold expiration date of day 5, an extension length of 3 days and one extension allowed. A request on day 4 moves the expiration date to day 8, counted from day 5 and not from the request day. A second request on day 7 is not granted, because the order has used its one extension.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A Kestrel Premium Certified order with expiration day 7 is extended on day 7 to day 10, and again on day 9 to day 13; it has then used both of its extensions.
